# Theme dependencies

Vendored from the npm releases, served locally through Hugo Pipes.

- [theme-change](https://github.com/saadeghi/theme-change), version 3.0.4, MIT. `index.mjs` is the unmodified ESM entry.
- [daisyUI](https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui), version 5.7.50, MIT. Only the thirteen unmodified theme CSS files are included, without component styles or a reset.

Keep the adjacent LICENSE files when updating. The daisyUI `--border` size is deliberately mapped to the blog border color in `css/themes.css`.
